verdict.rationale: Recurly documents a public API with official client libraries in seven languages, and at least one feature (entitlements) is explicitly checkable via the API. Nothing in the pack claims or shows that the API covers everything the UI can do. Most feature docs, such as subscription changes, invoice editing and imports/exports, describe capabilities without saying they are reachable through the API. Missing for 10: an explicit API–UI parity statement, per-feature API coverage documentation (subscription changes, invoice edits, dunning configuration, imports/exports), and independent or hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
